concerns.text: FR-004 and Plan.md mandate Mixed-Effects Logistic Regression (GLMM) to handle nested data. T026 explicitly implements 'Standard Logistic Regression (NOT GLMM)' and defers GLMM. No task exists to implement the GLMM model required by the plan and spec.

FR-006 requires applying multiple-comparison correction (Bonferroni OR Benjamini-Hochberg). T029 implements only Benjamini-Hochberg. No task covers the Bonferroni option or a mechanism to select between methods as implied by the 'e.g.' in FR-006.

SC-004 requires measuring decay of predictive power across sequence lengths (short vs. long). No task explicitly describes generating, splitting, or analyzing data subsets based on sequence length to perform this comparative analysis.

FR-007 mandates processing intermediate states in batches of 50 tokens. T021 and T041 mention 50-token and 500-row batches but lack a specific task ensuring the 50-token constraint is strictly enforced for the entropy extraction step to meet the 7GB RAM limit.

Spec Edge Cases require handling sequences exceeding 14GB disk via streaming/chunking. T021 and T041 focus on RAM limits and row counts. No task explicitly addresses the 14GB disk limit mechanism or streaming thresholds for disk overflow.

T006 (Foundational) and T023 (Phase 4) both define `validate_entropy_profile()` in `src/data/preprocessing.py`. This creates duplicate task definitions for the same function, causing ambiguity on which implementation is canonical.

T044 requires comparing checksums against 'HuggingFace dataset info hash'. The Spec and Constitution do not define a mechanism to fetch this dynamic hash, making the task potentially impossible to implement as described without external assumptions.
